description: A content campaign pays its creators from a cash prize pool the user deposits (the bounty); the best submissions, ranked by the owner, win it. Free — this sets the pool, it moves no money. TWO STEPS ON PURPOSE: (1) call WITHOUT confirmed: nothing is saved; you get the exact numbers — pool, the platform fee on top, total_due, and what each rank wins. Show them to the user. (2) Only after the user says yes, call again with confirmed:true: the pool is saved and you get fund_url — give that link to the user: it opens the campaign page at the deposit step, where they pay by card or USDC (signed in as the owner). The bounty is live once they deposit; check with get_content_campaign_results. Default token USDC; default split 1st 30% · ranks 2–5 20% · ranks 6–20 50% — for a small pool, suggest fewer winners so each prize is worth winning. A funded pool cannot be changed.

confirmed.description: Leave unset to preview. Set true ONLY after the user agreed to the numbers from the preview.

pool_amount.description: Prize pool paid to winners, in whole tokens (USDC ≈ dollars). The platform fee is added on top.

tiers.description: Prize bands from rank 1, no gaps, summing to 100. Omit for the default split.

percent.description: Share of the pool for this band, split evenly across its ranks

name: set_content_bounty
title: Set the cash bounty for a content campaign
